frameworkPolicy: Claude owns implementation architecture/framework selection. It may not trade away approved visible UI, behavior, accessibility or performance to simplify the stack.

consultationModal.mobile: bottom sheet or full-height drawer per master

backend.leadSubmission: provider-agnostic LeadSink abstraction; implementation may start with database/email/webhook adapter but no provider secret may be committed
backend.content: data source may be local content files or CMS, but route/component shape must remain stable
security: CSRF protection where framework architecture requires it
backend.errorHandling: return user-safe errors; log diagnostic details server-side without exposing secrets/PII

productionGate: facebookUrl resolved or corresponding outbound control intentionally disabled by Lucifer
production contact email/address verified if displayed
demo case studies/metrics/testimonials replaced or explicitly approved as demo
real service prices verified before public launch
